Write R code to construct an ExpressionSet and quantify group-wise gene expression variability using Biobase. At the beginning, load the required packages: library(Biobase). Write R code to summarize per-sample count distributions (mean and standard deviation) from a gene expression count matrix using BiocGenerics. Write R code to aggregate a large gene- or feature-level count matrix into per-sample total counts using BiocGenerics. At the beginning, load the required packages: library(BiocGenerics). Write R code to compute gene-wise mean expression from an RNA-seq count matrix using BiocParallel. At the beginning, load the required packages: library(BiocParallel). Write R code to compare serial versus multicore backends for per-sample count aggregation using BiocParallel. At the beginning, load the required packages: library(BiocParallel). Write R code to read and then rewrite a set of DNA sequences in FASTA format using Biostrings. Write R code to generate the reverse complement of a set of DNA sequences using Biostrings. At the beginning, load the required packages: library(Biostrings). Write R code to translate DNA sequences to protein sequences using Biostrings. Write R code to calculate per-sequence nucleotide composition using Biostrings. Using Biostrings, read the DNA sequences from `inputs/sequences.fasta` and count occurrences of the exact pattern `ATGC` in each sequence with `vcountPattern`. Write one row per sequence with columns `sequence` and `match_count` to `outputs/pattern_matches.csv`, without row names or quoted fields.

Write R code to generate a consensus sequence from multiple aligned DNA sequences using Biostrings. Write R code to perform gene-level ROC/AUC discrimination between two sample groups using genefilter. At the beginning, load the required packages: library(genefilter).
